Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017

official_measurement_examples.name: Protected status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Hazel dormice and their breeding and resting places are protected under the Habitats Regulations and related wildlife law.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning standing advice
official_measurement_examples.fact: Hazel-dormouse standing advice is a material planning consideration and was updated in April 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: A35 mitigation trigger
official_measurement_examples.fact: A35 is the mitigation route where work would otherwise unlawfully affect hazel dormice or their breeding or resting places.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL10a survey route
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL10a is a level 1 survey class licence and is distinct from development mitigation licensing.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL10b survey route
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL10b allows specified survey handling and temporary marking and does not authorise development impacts that need A35.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 class licence period
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current CL10 survey licences were updated in March 2026 and cover the 2026 to 2030 licence period subject to registration and conditions.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 reference evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England published separate survey-class reference and experience guidance on 3 June 2026 covering CL10a and CL10b applications.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Dormouse survey or licensing does not itself grant planning permission, prove species absence or determine parcel development capacity.

core_rules: hazel-dormouse protection law is not proof dormice are present on a parcel
dormouse survey result is not planning permission
planning permission is not an A35 mitigation licence
A35 mitigation licence is distinct from CL10a and CL10b survey licences
CL10a survey authority is not development mitigation authority
CL10b survey marking authority is not development mitigation authority
survey-class reference evidence is not a site result
planning standing advice is not a planning decision
historic dormouse survey must retain its date and survey method
absence of records is not proof of species absence without adequate evidence
licence conditions must be tied to actual works species and dates
dormouse protection does not determine land ownership
licensing does not reserve development capacity
dormouse compliance does not create access rights
no parcel dormouse clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
